impact_scope.description: The smallest fuzz-relevant unit is the existing spng_set_text compressed-text encoding path: write_chunks_before_idat replaces compress2 with internally initialized streaming deflate. The public setter and caller-supplied text structure are unchanged.

evidence: In S0, spng_set_text already exists and accepts the text array and count.
H0 only configures and exercises PNG decoding; it never calls spng_set_text or invokes an encoding path that writes compressed text chunks.
In S1, the same spng_set_text declaration and caller-facing inputs remain present and unchanged.
H0 remains decode-only and still does not call spng_set_text or exercise compressed-text encoding.

new_harness_obligation.description: S1 introduces no new H0 entry point, caller-supplied value or buffer, call-order transition, configuration, or special input construction. The deflate stream and ctx->text_options are passed and managed internally within the already-omitted encoding path.
evidence: The changed code is inside write_chunks_before_idat and does not alter the spng_set_text signature.
spng__deflate_init(ctx, &ctx->text_options) supplies the new internal compression setup automatically.
The same text content and compression_flag that selected compressed text in S0 select it in S1.

reason: For the identical existing compressed-text encoding unit, H0 has an exposure gap in both snapshots. The implementation changes from compress2 to streaming deflate, but the caller-visible route and controls are unchanged, so the fixed truth table yields UNCHANGED and no maintenance need.
